Jordan — thanks for the heads up and the usage snapshot. Appreciate the urgency.

Three potential paths we can offer quickly (happy to iterate):

1) Timebox extension (14 days) at no upfront charge — we grant an extension and cap burst capacity to 100k tokens/day. Any usage above a soft threshold (your current baseline) will be billed, but we'll convert up to $5k of overage into credits if you hit the scale run.

2) Credit conversion — 20% credit applied to incurred overage charges during the extension period (we can cap the credit to a maximum $5k). This keeps billing clean and helps your budget.

3) Paid short extension — flat fee of $3,000 to guarantee dedicated burst capacity and priority routing for the test window (useful if you need guaranteed throughput/SLA).

I'll loop in Marcus for pricing approval and Evelyn for any contractual amendment (small addendum). If you prefer option 2, I can prepare a DocuSign amend and get legal to OK wording. Which one would you like to proceed with?

If you need it quicker, we can provision the burst now and finalize paperwork after.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
